name: repeat-ai
description: Find and manage seller leads and connected WhatsApp activity in your Repeat AI account.

interface.longDescription: Use your connected Repeat AI account to find seller leads, read seller details, and review connected WhatsApp accounts and message history. Add seller records, update notes or contact status, and request individual WhatsApp messages with explicit confirmation. Intended for property agents managing their own seller workspace. Requires a Repeat AI account and an eligible subscription. Writes require approval in a supported native form or on a separate Repeat AI page using email/password sign-in. This plugin does not currently provide property-listing search, spreadsheet imports, calendar scheduling, or email tools.
defaultPrompt: Help me update a seller's notes.
